in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who wears the lord of all lords (Indra) as clothes

in_marathi.name: Digambar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Digambar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name for those who have renounced worldly possessions and live a life devoted to spiritual pursuits. In Hindu mythology, Digambar is another name for Lord Vishnu, who is depicted as naked, symbolizing his freedom from material desires.
